prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 深色或蓝色文件夹作为纪念物，禁止可读学校文字。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use a clean diploma folder or graduation document sleeve as a prop. Keep any text and emblem fictional or unreadable.

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 用于教室、窗边和操场坐姿，强化校园生活感。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use one notebook, workbook, or book as a believable campus prop. Keep the hand interaction simple and readable.

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 宽肩灰西装、丝巾或简洁衬衫，适合城市职业电影。

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 一只结构简洁的通勤手提包。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use one restrained structured briefcase or work bag held naturally at the side.

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 细耳机线或入耳式耳机，作为轻量校园生活细节。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Add simple wired earphones as a subtle campus-life prop. Keep cables readable and do not let them cross the face awkwardly.

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 深色不透明墨镜 · 安全模式
prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 深色或镜面墨镜，眼睛必须完全隐藏。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use coherent opaque or mirrored sunglasses. Hide both eyes fully behind the lenses. Never render pupils, irises, eyelashes, or duplicate eye details through the lenses.

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 抬起或手持墨镜 · 身份优先
prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 需要保留眼神时，将墨镜抬起或握在手中。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: When eye identity matters, place sunglasses above the eyes or held in one hand so both eyes remain naturally visible.

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 半透明染色镜片 · 条件模式
prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 半透明镜片只允许柔和、低对比的眼部暗示。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use translucent tinted lenses only conditionally. Any implied eyes must remain soft, low-contrast, anatomically aligned, and subordinate to lens tint and reflections.

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 宽松炭灰居家套装，适合窗边日常。

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 屋顶黄昏路线中的浅色层次载体。

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 女性灰色卫衣居家造型

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 墙面照片和便签作为生活痕迹，不得抢脸。

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 女性毛领风动封面造型

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 女性粉蓝天空卫衣造型

prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use a thick pale blue-grey scarf with visible layered folds and clean jaw separation.

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 白色褶边、肩线与背部轮廓在林间柔光中保持层次。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use an ivory ruffle dress with protected highlight detail and soft romantic structure.

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 单一长丝带沿发丝方向自然垂落。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use one long white ribbon tied into the hairstyle; keep attachment and gravity plausible.

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 秋日钟形帽与棕色针织造型
prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 棕色帽饰与针织外套配合深林逆光。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use a brown cloche-style hat and textured knit outer layer with autumn rim light.

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 手中仅保留一片主要秋叶，飘落叶片作为远近层。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use one hero autumn leaf held between separated fingers; background leaves remain depth-layered.

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 暗色肩线风动近景造型
prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 暗色简洁上装为风动发丝和混合光让位。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use a simple dark upper-body silhouette with a clear shoulder line and no distracting accessories.

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 满天星、绒感围巾和支撑结构共同形成花冠。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Build a physically plausible baby-breath halo with visible stem support and fuzzy scarf structure.

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 单枝花可遮挡一只眼睛，但必须保留另一只眼和花枝来源。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use one flower stem as an eye occluder while keeping the stem visible and the other eye readable.

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 牛仔外套与绿色围巾花冠造型
prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 牛仔、绿色围巾与花材保持材质分离。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use denim outerwear and a soft green scarf beneath the halo, keeping petals, stems, scarf, and skin separate.

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 炭灰大衣与白围巾通勤造型
prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 炭灰大衣和白围巾形成简洁冬日通勤层次。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use a charcoal coat with an oversized white scarf; keep scarf folds, shoulders, and face cleanly separated.

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 炭灰西装与罗纹高领咖啡馆造型
prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 深色裁剪外套、高领针织和克制配饰形成成熟都市感。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use a charcoal tailored coat, ribbed turtleneck, restrained gold earrings, and polished loafers.

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 咖啡杯、书本与耳机生活道具
prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 咖啡、书本、报纸和耳机用于建立动作因果。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use a coffee glass, open book, foreground newspaper edge, or wired earphones only when hands and table plane remain coherent.

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 城市宽松针织倚靠造型
prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 宽松灰色针织用于形成手臂、栏杆和体积关系。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use an oversized textured knit with clear sleeve folds and arm-to-railing contact.

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 黄色交通工具街头配饰造型
prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 黑大衣、长围巾、帽饰与透明或浅色镜片形成街头编辑感。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use a black coat, long charcoal scarf, cap, and optional tinted clear-lens glasses while preserving optical surface logic.

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 牛仔外套与自然发丝用于海岸线轻风叙事。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use a denim outer layer with restrained wind-led hair and clean shoulder silhouette.

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 枝叶、花瓶或叶影属于真实前景和投影来源。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use one physical branch, vase, or leaf cluster as a traceable foreground and shadow source.

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 红灯笼通过手柄与手臂形成明确可达关系。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use one red lantern with readable handle, tassel, hand reach, and gravity direction.

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 纹样外层、红色下装和发饰形成节庆叙事轮廓。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use a layered riverside festival outfit with restrained pattern density and clear seated silhouette.

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 白衬衫黑领带阔腿裤棚拍造型
prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 宽松白衬衫、黑领带、阔腿裤和黑鞋形成极简男装感。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use a loose white shirt, black tie, wide black trousers, and grounded black shoes.

prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 康乃馨花枝可进入口袋、手部或地面，但必须具有附着和重力逻辑。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use carnation stems in pockets, hands, or on the floor plane; keep stems, gravity, and contact physically legible.

prop_wardrobe_presets.name_zh: 猩红海报黑色廓形造型
prop_wardrobe_presets.summary: 黑色宽松廓形和厚底鞋用于夸张缩短透视。
prop_wardrobe_presets.module_instruction_en: Use a black oversized silhouette and grounded statement footwear suitable for controlled foreshortening.

layout_modules.summary: 在大幅人物底图前叠加票券、邮票或网页弹窗式中央卡片，卡内展示第二张人物图和可替换产品，适合眼镜、首饰、服装和线下快闪视觉。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Overlay a centered perforated-ticket or popup-card panel on top of a larger portrait. Inside the card, include a secondary portrait crop, a replaceable fashion accessory or product silhouette, a fictional event-information zone, and clean commercial spacing. Do not use real brands, product models, or logos.

layout_modules.name_zh: 多切片数码道具地下刊
layout_modules.summary: 使用一张主肖像、一个或多个人物切片、手机或小屏幕、贴纸、涂鸦、网页导航条与搜索框，将人物包装成具有千禧年网络杂志感的地下刊封面。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Build a layered underground digital-zine collage with one dominant portrait, one or two secondary cutout poses, abstract flip-phone or mini-screen props, sticker-like accents, a restrained browser-navigation strip or search bar, and controlled handwritten marks. Keep the hierarchy readable and use fictional devices and interface text only.

layout_modules.name_zh: 头像贴纸冬日手帐拼贴
layout_modules.summary: 围绕真实人物主肖像叠加动漫头像副图、像素装饰、红色格纹、星星、四叶草、季节小物和软萌道具，形成社交媒体手帐式拼贴。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Keep the recognizable real subject as the main portrait. Add one or two small fictional anime-avatar sticker panels, pixel or ASCII decorations, seasonal plaid, simple stars, clover motifs, and a few cozy objects such as a plush toy or dessert plate. Keep the layout playful but controlled and do not replace the main subject with an animated character.

layout_modules.name_zh: 巨型文字压景诗意构图
layout_modules.summary: 人物缩小为画面中的情绪锚点，巨型衬线和手写字覆盖环境纹理，适合纪念、旅行、音乐与情绪主题。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Make typography the dominant visual mass. Reduce the subject to a small but intentional figure within a textured environment and reserve large zones for oversized serif words and sweeping handwritten script. Keep the subject readable as an emotional anchor rather than the primary graphic mass.

layout_modules.summary: 双手在镜头前形成几何框景，辅以细线、节点、日期、图标和纵向宣言字，强调主体凝视与自我表达。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Compose the portrait with both hands framing the face in the foreground. Add restrained interface lines, geometric nodes, small date zones, and a bold vertical manifesto-title area. Keep the hands anatomically plausible and ensure that the eyes remain unobstructed.

layout_modules.name_zh: 手机屏幕跃出双人构图
layout_modules.summary: 手机模型作为舞台，双人或多人从屏幕中跃出，适合朋友、搭档、情侣和社群成员的关系型海报。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a tilted smartphone as a miniature stage or portal. Place two or more recognizable subjects emerging from the screen with controlled perspective, simple star or sticker accents, name-label zones, and a limited graphic palette. The device should organize the composition without overpowering the subjects.

layout_modules.summary: 一人前景虚焦，一人门框后景清晰。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a candid foreground-background composition: one subject softly blurred in the near foreground and the other clearly framed in a doorway or deeper layer.
layout_modules.instruction_en: Use a candid foreground-background composition: one subject softly blurred in the near foreground and the other clearly framed in a doorway or deeper layer.

layout_modules.summary: 贴近拥抱、自然笑容与生活感。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a close, spontaneous couple embrace with real smiles and warm documentary intimacy.
layout_modules.instruction_en: Use a close, spontaneous couple embrace with real smiles and warm documentary intimacy.

layout_modules.summary: 礼制婚礼和暗调棚拍的标准正式构图。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a formal full-length symmetrical couple composition with clear posture and disciplined spacing.
layout_modules.instruction_en: Use a formal full-length symmetrical couple composition with clear posture and disciplined spacing.

layout_modules.summary: 红纱包裹前景或局部空间，人物脸部保持完整。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a red-veil intimate close-up with translucent foreground layers, keeping both complete faces readable.
layout_modules.instruction_en: Use a red-veil intimate close-up with translucent foreground layers, keeping both complete faces readable.

layout_modules.summary: 一张主图和三张辅助切片。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Create a four-panel wedding editorial grid with one dominant image and three disciplined secondary crops. Keep identities consistent.
layout_modules.instruction_en: Create a four-panel wedding editorial grid with one dominant image and three disciplined secondary crops. Keep identities consistent.

layout_modules.summary: 红包、托盘、扇子或冰淇淋等道具互动。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a playful duo composition organized around one or two restrained props and natural interaction.
layout_modules.instruction_en: Use a playful duo composition organized around one or two restrained props and natural interaction.

layout_modules.summary: 窗边、玻璃倒影与留白结合的诗意构图。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a window-side portrait with glass reflections, clean negative space, and a readable face.
layout_modules.instruction_en: Use a window-side portrait with glass reflections, clean negative space, and a readable face.

layout_modules.summary: 人物一侧保持清晰，另一侧进入墨裂和飞溅。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Keep one side of the portrait readable while the other dissolves into directional ink fracture and dry-brush motion.
layout_modules.instruction_en: Keep one side of the portrait readable while the other dissolves into directional ink fracture and dry-brush motion.

layout_modules.summary: 人物居中或偏侧，保留标题与姓名区域。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Reserve a clean outer-margin title zone and a lower caption band for graduate name, major, date, and Class Of text. Keep all accurate typography for SVG or HTML post-layout.

layout_modules.summary: 扶手与楼梯形成方向线，人物轻回望或缓慢下行。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use stair rails and steps as diagonal guides. Keep the subject clear, preserve the neck line, and reserve the quieter wall area for post-layout captions.

layout_modules.summary: 人物可缩小，但必须保持识别性和仪式感。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use strict central perspective with generous white negative space. Keep the graduate large enough to remain recognizable and place typography only in outer safe zones.

layout_modules.summary: 前景座椅虚焦，主体在中后景清晰。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Frame the graduate through lecture-hall seats or classroom furniture. Let foreground objects create depth without covering the face, neck, or active hands.

layout_modules.summary: 允许上下或左右双画格，后期叠加日期和短标题。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Create a restrained two-frame yearbook composition using two compatible portrait crops. Keep the hero face dominant and reserve a slim margin for accurate post-layout text.

layout_modules.summary: 树木形成天然纵向框架，人物全身或三分之二身停驻。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use tree trunks and filtered light as a natural frame for a full-body or three-quarter graduation portrait. Reserve open foliage or path zones for restrained captions.

layout_modules.summary: 人物靠近皮椅扶手，半身近景，侧边留白。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a refined half-body crop with one leather chair arm as a grounding prop. Reserve one side margin for a restrained caption.

layout_modules.summary: 四宫格只用于后期拼贴，底图仍保持单一稳定动作。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Create one clean hero portrait base suitable for a later four-frame editorial set. Do not generate four inconsistent faces inside the base image.

layout_modules.summary: 建筑立面与街道纵深承载全身通勤步伐。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Frame a full-body urban walking portrait with readable coat silhouette, one active prop hand, and clear city depth.

layout_modules.summary: 楼梯坐姿和手部动作可作为多图编辑素材，但每张底图保持单一动作。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Generate one stairwell editorial portrait per frame with one clear action only; later collage assembly belongs to post-layout.

layout_modules.name_zh: 中性灰西装三分之二身
layout_modules.summary: 灰底、肩线、领带和手部形成极简编辑结构。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a clean three-quarter studio portrait that prioritizes shoulder line, loose tie, pockets, and a readable face.

layout_modules.summary: 红色圆盘、两侧剪影与中心人物构成强视觉舞台。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Center the subject against one red circular backlight. Keep side silhouettes abstract and never let them obscure the face.

layout_modules.summary: 前景座椅、中心人物和后排暗部形成纵深框景。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use lecture-hall seats as a layered frame. Keep one hero face clear in the central light beam and avoid visual clutter.

layout_modules.summary: 窗框、散热器与课桌形成清透校园环境。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Frame a half-body classroom-window portrait with workbook or folder, cool daylight, and open wall space for later captions.

layout_modules.summary: 窗边桌面、咖啡杯与半身人物。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Frame a half-body or seated portrait beside a window table; keep the source side visible or inferable.

layout_modules.summary: 钢琴、地图与侧向凝望。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use piano or map depth with a quiet close-up and one clear off-frame gaze.

layout_modules.summary: 人物、草地与列车形成横向层次。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a wide rural frame with distant trainline and a single readable subject silhouette.

layout_modules.summary: 夜路车流与肩部回望。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a night-street shoulder backturn with environmental bokeh and a clear face plane.

layout_modules.summary: 门框交界、全身站姿与冷暖边界。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a full-body doorway composition with the subject bridging two lighting zones.

layout_modules.summary: 铁艺栏杆前景、低机位与肩颈线。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a low-angle stairwell portrait with railing foreground kept below or around the face, never cutting critical landmarks.

layout_modules.summary: 珠宝、手部与面部形成单一视觉锚点。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a warm close portrait with one pearl strand or earring highlight and a clean hand-face boundary.

layout_modules.summary: 白底坐凳、玫瑰与定向阳光斑。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a stool portrait with roses held low and one directional studio sun patch.

layout_modules.summary: 脸部、手部与墙面共享统一投影方向。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a close crop with connected hard-shadow bands across wall, hand, knit, and facial planes. Keep eyes readable.

layout_modules.summary: 沙发、杂志、手部和阳光斑形成安静编辑构图。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a seated or reclined couch composition with one magazine and controlled negative space.

layout_modules.summary: 高机位俯拍餐桌，人物转头重新找到镜头。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a high-angle snapshot composition. Keep the table context visible while prioritizing the subject face and camera grip.

layout_modules.summary: 书架、耳机与坐姿构成轻松日常。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use shelves as a layered environmental frame. Avoid clutter crossing the face.

layout_modules.summary: 门口日光、背包和耳机形成年轻化抓拍。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a low casual crouch near a storefront or railing. Keep knees, elbows, and backpack readable.

layout_modules.summary: 床边或白桌旁的人物近景，允许叶影和条纹影。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a close or half-body window composition with sourced dapple or slat shadows and one coffee cup.

layout_modules.summary: 相机靠近眼部但不遮挡全部脸部。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a three-quarter street crop with a compact camera lifted toward one eye and a readable wink or squint.

layout_modules.summary: 门洞、单臂倚靠和小道具构成九十年代街头感。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a doorway lean with one free hand and one optional small prop. Preserve shoulder and wrist anatomy.

layout_modules.summary: 低太阳和开阔背景构成男性侧脸近景。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a close three-quarter or profile crop against an open field. Keep the sun source low and side-rear.

layout_modules.name_zh: 暖色窄束贴脸切片构图
layout_modules.summary: 窄束暖光跨越嘴唇、鼻梁或眼睑，暗部占据大部分画面。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a close portrait through a soft foreground veil. Let one narrow warm beam slice cross selected facial planes while preserving recognition landmarks.

layout_modules.name_zh: 暖光斑黑衣白布坐姿构图
layout_modules.summary: 黑色身体轮廓与白色垂布之间保留一个局部暖色面部光池。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a seated or kneeling composition on white drape with a small face-centered warm pool and low cool ambient.

layout_modules.summary: 报纸遮住下半脸，眼睛和窗光成为视觉锚点。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a frontal or mild three-quarter crop with newspaper below the eyes, storefront reflections behind, and warm window sun near the hairline.

layout_modules.name_zh: 咖啡馆捧杯暖光池构图
layout_modules.summary: 双手捧杯、暖色外套和斜向阳光构成生活方式瞬间。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a counter-side seated composition with both hands around one cup and one oblique sun pool across coat and floor.

layout_modules.name_zh: 海边黄昏直闪风动近景
layout_modules.summary: 风动长发、肩部回看和暗色海岸构成近距离旅行抓拍。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a close or half-body dusk beach portrait with windblown hair and near-lens flash. Keep horizon low and background darker.

layout_modules.summary: 人物俯卧或倚靠沙地，手持贝壳形成轻松互动。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a low sand-level composition with one shell and clear forearm support. Keep flash shadow short and sand texture local.

layout_modules.name_zh: 屋顶蓝调侧脸轮廓构图
layout_modules.summary: 侧脸与暖色发丝边缘光对抗蓝调天空。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a medium profile or three-quarter rooftop portrait against layered dusk clouds. Keep rim confined to source-facing edges.

layout_modules.name_zh: 屋顶蓝调双手入袋构图
layout_modules.summary: 浅色风衣、双手入袋与正面或三分之二视角构成安静站姿。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a medium standing crop with hands in coat pockets, warm hair edge, and restrained face recovery.

layout_modules.name_zh: 旷野木椅低太阳远景构图
layout_modules.summary: 田野留白、椅坐人物和低太阳形成叙事性远景。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a wide field composition with one chair, long shadow, and ample sky or grass negative space.

layout_modules.name_zh: 风动发丝贴脸封面构图
layout_modules.summary: 超近景，发丝穿过面部，标题位于下方留白。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use an extreme close-up with wind-led hair crossing forehead, cheek, and lips; reserve a lower-third title zone outside core landmarks.

layout_modules.name_zh: 低照度抬手进入光斑构图
layout_modules.summary: 抬手进入暖色光池，让手部和脸部共同解释光源。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a medium or close portrait with one raised hand entering the warm patch; keep all fingers readable.

layout_modules.name_zh: 低照度指尖靠近下巴构图
layout_modules.summary: 指尖靠近下巴或嘴唇，暖光斑保持局部。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a close crop with one index finger near chin or lip line, without covering the mouth or fusing fingers.

layout_modules.name_zh: 黄金时刻侧脸眩光构图
layout_modules.summary: 侧脸、低太阳与发丝轮廓光形成柔和开阔肖像。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a medium or close profile with the low sun near the frame edge and restrained lens-axis flare.

layout_modules.name_zh: 黄金时刻抬下巴逆光构图
layout_modules.summary: 轻抬下巴，让发丝与颈部进入逆光边缘。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a close chin-lift profile with warm backlight and gentle flare; preserve neck line and skin gradient.

layout_modules.name_zh: 黄昏横向奔跑拖影构图
layout_modules.summary: 人物横向经过镜头，背景光轨与动作方向一致。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a side-pass horizontal panning composition with one readable body line and crisp editorial text outside the subject.

layout_modules.name_zh: 黄昏回身肩线拖影构图
layout_modules.summary: 近景肩线回转，脸部保留一个可识别锚点。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a shoulder-turn near-camera motion portrait with one readable eye or lip contour and compatible streak direction.

layout_modules.name_zh: 卧室照片墙玩偶坐姿构图
layout_modules.summary: 照片墙、窗边和小熊玩偶构成真实休息片段。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a seated corner portrait with photo wall and one teddy bear, keeping facial space uncluttered.

layout_modules.summary: 人物靠窗，双拳轻托下巴，看向窗外。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a window-frame portrait with both fists lightly under the chin and a quiet off-frame gaze.

layout_modules.name_zh: 卧室头戴耳机近景构图
layout_modules.summary: 头戴耳机与灰色卫衣构成轻松近景。
layout_modules.module_instruction_en: Use a close or medium portrait while touching one headphone ear cup; keep headband and eyes clear.

layout_modules.name_zh: 桌边伸手暖窗光近景构图

action_presets.summary: A paparazzi caught them in an unguarded moment — she laughs at something he said, he looks away pretending not to notice.
action_presets.direction_en: Subject shifts weight onto rear leg, she turns toward camera mid-laugh, he angles away with one hand in jacket pocket — peak authentic moment, not performed expression.

action_presets.summary: Director called 'whisper something in her ear' — she reacts with genuine surprise rather than holding a pose.
action_presets.direction_en: She turns away slightly, he leans in with mouth near her ear, her hand rises to his shoulder in response — off-camera mutual gaze, not looking at lens.

action_presets.summary: The moment before or after the cut — subject exists in transition, back to camera, breath between scenes.
action_presets.direction_en: Subject turns back to camera, looking over shoulder at something outside frame — weight on back foot, hand may hold cigarette or cup, breath held in transition.

action_presets.summary: She adjusts her headdress in the mirror, he stands half-out of frame behind her — the before that matters.
action_presets.direction_en: She faces mirror diagonally, fingers adjusting headdress with slight self-consciousness, he visible only partially at edge — candid morning energy, not ceremony posture.

action_presets.summary: Someone said something real and both are laughing — not the 'say cheese' smile, the real one.
action_presets.direction_en: Both bodies slightly turned toward each other, not centered in frame, she places hand on his chest in genuine reaction — mutual gaze, eyes crinkled, not held smile.

action_presets.summary: After the chaos, a quiet breath — she looks at her ring, he looks at her, the frame is still.
action_presets.direction_en: She lowers gaze to ring on her finger, he stands behind not in direct frame — introspective stillness, soft or closed eyes, hands may rest near face or clasp loosely.

action_presets.summary: They exist in the space without performing — grand stillness like a Chen Kaige frame, not a wedding ad.
action_presets.direction_en: Both stand front or three-quarter with low-center weight, he places hand gently at her back not waist, her hands clasp at front holding fan — off-camera gaze into middle distance.

action_presets.summary: She looks up at him, he just said something private — asymmetric intimacy, not staged couple gaze.
action_presets.direction_en: She tilts head back slightly looking up, he lowers chin toward her, her hand rests on his lapel, his hand at his side — private mutual gaze, not broadcast moment.

action_presets.summary: The entry moment — she walks toward or he waits, the space between them is the subject.
action_presets.direction_en: Full body processional framing, she holds bouquet with both hands or one, he may stand with one hand clasped behind back — gaze forward or toward each other, weight forward.

action_presets.summary: They carry their heritage with weight — not performing tradition but embodying it, brocade as ceremony.
action_presets.direction_en: Full body three-quarter or side, low-center weight for gravitas, hands clasped in front or she holds small ornamental prop — eyes into ceremony meaning, not at camera.

action_presets.summary: The break between posed shots — her hand on his chest, his expression softening in genuine moment.
action_presets.direction_en: She stands closer to him than formal editorial allows, he receives it openly, her hand on his chest or arm, his hand at side — he looks at her, she may look away.

action_presets.summary: The brocade moves — wind, step, turn — fabric is alive and the person inhabits the motion.
action_presets.direction_en: Body mid-turn or stride, weight off-center for dynamic tension, one hand holds fabric edge adjusting drape, free hand gesture — fabric at maximum movement, gaze camera or off-camera.

action_presets.summary: The formal bow — hands clasped at chest or forehead, weight shifting forward, ceremony is the architecture.
action_presets.direction_en: Front or three-quarter, weight shifts forward with formal alignment, hands clasped in ceremonial position — eyes down or closed, deep respect moment, no casual hand positions.

action_presets.summary: Presenting tea or incense — ritual object held with both hands, formal presentation to elder or altar.
action_presets.direction_en: Kneeling or half-kneel, formal orientation toward recipient or altar, holding vessel with both hands in formal presentation grip — respectful downcast gaze, ceremony execution.

action_presets.summary: Standing at attention — guardian of ceremony, not the star. Ceremony is architecture, they are part of it.
action_presets.direction_en: Full body, weight balanced, posture upright in ceremonial posture, hands clasped in formal position at front or sides — present at ceremony, eyes not at camera.

action_presets.summary: Doing the big dramatic opera sleeve flip but laughing while doing it — joy and tradition in one gesture.
action_presets.direction_en: One arm extended with dramatic sleeve gesture, weight on back foot, other hand may touch partner or hold fan — genuine laughter, not solemnity, caught mid-gesture.

action_presets.summary: Someone called out her opera headdress is askew — she adjusts it with a smile, self-conscious and real.
action_presets.direction_en: Casual stance not formal pose, one hand touches and adjusts headdress with slight awkwardness, other hand holds fan or free — eyes up looking at who called it out, caught mid-adjustment.

action_presets.summary: Fan is extension of body, not held still — mid-dance movement, prop as limb, not accessory.
action_presets.direction_en: One leg weighted, one arm extended with fan held by fingertips not death grip, body mid-dance turn — gaze off-camera caught in dance rhythm, fan at maximum extension.

action_presets.summary: Hand rests on scabbard, blade not drawn — coiled potential energy, tension in the stillness before the release.
action_presets.direction_en: Weight low-center, one foot slightly forward, shoulders square to opponent direction, one hand rests on scabbard top not gripping, other hand free at side — sharp focused gaze past camera.

action_presets.summary: The scene that exists between ink splatters — subject is part of the painting, pause between action and thought.
action_presets.direction_en: Three-quarter or side, weight off-center for visual tension, one hand may hold brush or touch knee if seated — eyes closed or soft gaze, the breath before next move.

action_presets.summary: Striding through ink smoke — fabric and hair in wind, motion blur is the point, not the obstacle.
action_presets.direction_en: Full body mid-stride, weight forward, one hand pushes through smoke or against wind, sword held loosely — gaze forward or up into journey, fabric at maximum wind movement.

action_presets.summary: Ink is not behind the person — it is becoming the person. Smoke and flesh are one texture.
action_presets.direction_en: Front or three-quarter, weight balanced, hands near face or on chest in ink gesture — eyes open but looking into smoke void, not at camera, becoming the smoke not standing in it.

action_presets.summary: Red ink has just splashed — hands raised near face as if catching or recoiling from the vermillion moment.
action_presets.direction_en: Weight off-center caught mid-gesture, hands raised near face and head in reactive motion — eyes wide the moment of splash impact, not a posed reaction but instinctive.

action_presets.summary: Back to camera, looking into the ink — the person is part of the void, dissolving into the medium.
action_presets.direction_en: Back or three-quarter back, weight low-center, one hand may be raised as if conducting smoke — no gaze (back to camera) or eyes closed, figure dissolves into ink.

action_presets.summary: Paparazzi caught her backstage — not the perfect take but the real one, 1970s idol magazine authenticity.
action_presets.direction_en: Casual lean against wall or doorframe not standing at attention, one hand touches hair or nearby prop, relaxed — gaze off-camera at something off-set, not posing.

action_presets.summary: Director said 'wait' — subject in character but frozen between expressions, a beat before the line.
action_presets.direction_en: Full body in directed pose, hand near face touching cheek or chin in thinking gesture — off-camera gaze, character thinking not performing, the beat before the next line.

action_presets.summary: Shooting the breeze — casual and relaxed with no idea a photo was accidentally taken.
action_presets.direction_en: Casual turn or lean, one shoulder to camera, hand in pocket or one hand touching partner — gaze mutual or off-camera, not posing, the accidental capture moment.

action_presets.summary: Looking out at rain or city — not crying, not smiling, just existing in the blue melancholy.
action_presets.direction_en: Three-quarter to window, weight off-center, one hand on windowsill or touching glass, other arm crossed — gaze off-camera at rain or night, caught in mood not performing it.

action_presets.summary: The moment before the cut — subject in transition between emotions, breath before the next scene.
action_presets.direction_en: Front, weight balanced not rigid, one hand near face touching temple chin or lips in thinking gesture — off-camera gaze in private moment, the breath between scenes.

action_presets.summary: Walking toward or away from something — narrative is happening off-frame, motion is the story.
action_presets.direction_en: In motion, weight forward, three-quarter or back to camera, natural walking gesture one hand may hold jacket collar or bag strap — gaze off-camera into story direction.

action_presets.summary: Seated in a way that makes the magazine cover — not sitting, posing with severity that becomes icon.
action_presets.direction_en: Seated asymmetric with weight on one hip, one leg crossed, one hand on knee other arm draped over chair back or suspended — off-camera gaze past viewer into middle distance.

action_presets.summary: Body as vertical architectural element in composition — not performing, existing, the frame is built around the stillness.
action_presets.direction_en: Front, weight low-center, shoulders back, chin slightly up, hands at sides or one hand in pocket but pocket-stuffing too casual for grey fashion — gaze not for viewer, off-camera.

action_presets.summary: Between shots — the real moment behind the severity, high fashion actor in pause not on mark.
action_presets.direction_en: Leaning against wall or doorframe not at the mark, one hand holds phone water bottle or touches face casually — gaze at something off-camera not at camera, the real moment.

action_presets.summary: The classic 80s HK star pose — cigarette, hard gaze, not smiling, slightly dangerous and real.
action_presets.direction_en: Weight off-center, one hip out, shoulder angled to camera, one hand holds cigarette at side or near face — hard direct gaze off-camera-left into distance or at off-stage light.

action_presets.summary: The dramatic sweep — hair, coat, gaze all moving as one direction, the arc is the point.
action_presets.direction_en: Full body weight forward, mid-sweep turn, one arm extended in gesture direction, coat and hair in motion — gaze in direction of gesture not at camera, sweep at maximum arc.

action_presets.summary: Camera pushed in — celebrity in private moment, not at the mark, the public figure in intimate space.
action_presets.direction_en: Close crop face fills frame, body posture implied not explicit, one hand may touch face hair or be near chin — off-camera intimate gaze, private moment public figure.

action_presets.summary: 一手抱文件夹，一手自然挥手，适合晴日毕业祝福画面。
action_presets.direction_en: Hold a diploma folder close to the torso with one arm and lift the other hand in a natural wave. Keep fingers readable and shoulders relaxed.

action_presets.summary: 将学位帽抬高，动作明确但不遮脸。
action_presets.direction_en: Raise one academic cap above the head with a clear elbow line. Keep the bouquet or diploma in the other hand only if the silhouette remains clean.

action_presets.summary: 怀抱花束，柔和看镜头，适合稳定成片。
action_presets.direction_en: Hold one bouquet below chest level and look softly toward camera. Keep the bouquet away from the jawline and preserve the complete neck.

action_presets.summary: 侧脸或半侧脸停驻，强调祝福感和留白。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a three-quarter or side-profile pause while holding the bouquet below the shoulder line. Direct the gaze into a single off-frame target.

action_presets.summary: 楼梯间缓慢移动，身体先转，颈部轻回。
action_presets.direction_en: Place the subject on a stair landing with one hand resting on the rail. Turn the body first, then use only a mild neck return toward camera.

action_presets.summary: 一手扶栏杆，一手持花束，低头缓慢下楼。
action_presets.direction_en: Walk slowly down the stairs with one hand on the railing and one hand holding a bouquet or folder. Keep the gaze downward and the steps anatomically believable.

action_presets.name_zh: 教室窗边持册画外凝望
action_presets.summary: 坐在窗边，单手持册，看向统一画外目标。
action_presets.direction_en: Sit beside a classroom window with one notebook open or held loosely. Direct gaze toward one coherent off-frame target.

action_presets.summary: 座椅前后景形成框景，托腮或伏桌直视。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a lecture-hall or desk-side chin-rest pose with elbows supported and the face fully visible. Keep the gaze softly directed toward camera.

action_presets.summary: 草地坐姿、文件夹或课本靠近膝部，安静停留。
action_presets.direction_en: Sit naturally on a lawn with knees or legs arranged clearly and one folder or book resting near the lap. Keep the torso relaxed and the face readable.

action_presets.summary: 人物站立，花束靠近身体，抬头看向高处画外。
action_presets.direction_en: Stand beside a campus fence or tree line while holding one bouquet close to the torso. Lift the gaze upward into a single off-frame target.

action_presets.summary: 半身靠近皮椅，单手轻靠颈侧，柔和看镜头。
action_presets.direction_en: Sit or lean beside a leather chair arm. Rest one hand lightly near the side of the neck without compressing the jaw or hiding the neck line.

action_presets.summary: 坐姿或屈膝，单手托腮，保持脸与手边界。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a relaxed seated pose against a textured wall. Rest one cheek lightly on one hand while keeping finger boundaries and the jaw line clean.

action_presets.summary: 一手轻放腰侧，身体略微倾斜。
action_presets.direction_en: Stand with one hand resting naturally at the waist and the other arm relaxed. Use a mild body lean and clear shoulder line.

action_presets.summary: 手持咖啡与手提包，城市街头自然行走。
action_presets.direction_en: Walk naturally through the city with one coffee cup and one structured briefcase. Keep stride believable and the face readable.

action_presets.summary: 楼梯坐姿，一手托腮，另一手自然垂落。
action_presets.direction_en: Sit on a stair step with one hand lightly supporting the cheek and the other hand relaxed. Keep elbows, wrists, and jaw boundaries distinct.

action_presets.summary: 双手靠近头发但不遮眼，不压缩颈部。
action_presets.direction_en: Raise both hands toward the hair with elbows readable. Keep both eyes visible, avoid covering the face, and preserve the neck line.

action_presets.summary: 一手或双手插袋，肩线清楚。
action_presets.direction_en: Stand in a relaxed tailored suit with one or both hands naturally in pockets. Keep the loose tie, shirt collar, and shoulder line readable.

action_presets.summary: 低头整理领带，动作单一且手部清楚。
action_presets.direction_en: Stand against a red circular backlight and adjust the tie with one clear hand action. Use downward gaze and preserve clean wrist and finger anatomy.

action_presets.summary: 讲堂座椅间轻托腮，中心窗光，柔和直视。
action_presets.direction_en: Sit naturally among lecture-hall seats. Rest the chin lightly near folded arms or one hand and keep the jaw boundary readable.

action_presets.summary: 窗边抱住文件夹或笔记本，耳机线保持清楚。
action_presets.direction_en: Stand beside a classroom window while holding one folder or notebook close to the torso. Keep earphone cables simple and away from the face.

action_presets.summary: 窗边轻抿咖啡，动作单一。
action_presets.direction_en: Sit beside the window and lift one ceramic cup naturally.

action_presets.summary: 靠窗停顿，画外凝望。
action_presets.direction_en: Lean near the window with a relaxed off-frame gaze.

action_presets.summary: 钢琴边轻托腮，颈部完整。
action_presets.direction_en: Sit near the piano with one hand close to the mouth or chin while keeping jaw separation.

action_presets.summary: 旷野持小琴，动作清楚。
action_presets.direction_en: Stand in the field holding one small instrument with both hands readable.

action_presets.summary: 单肩背包、步行与黄昏。
action_presets.direction_en: Walk naturally with one backpack strap and a coherent off-frame target.

action_presets.summary: 草地坐姿，人物边界清楚。
action_presets.direction_en: Sit in dry grass with relaxed shoulders and one clear face direction.

action_presets.summary: 夜路肩部回望，环境动感。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a mild shoulder backturn while walking at night; body turns first and neck reacquires the camera lightly.

action_presets.summary: 门框站姿，跨越冷暖光区。
action_presets.direction_en: Lean within the doorway with one clear body line and no cigarette dependency.

action_presets.summary: 低机位栏杆前景，肩颈线完整。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a low-angle stairwell lean while keeping railing foreground below the critical face region.

action_presets.summary: 楼梯回望与低照度空间。
action_presets.direction_en: Turn shoulder and head mildly across the railing while preserving jaw-neck geometry.

action_presets.summary: 珍珠链与手部形成单一视觉锚点。
action_presets.direction_en: Hold one pearl strand near the face with readable fingers and restrained jewelry highlights.

action_presets.summary: 暖夜轻托腮，手脸边界清楚。
action_presets.direction_en: Rest the chin lightly on one hand while preserving jaw separation.

action_presets.summary: 白底坐凳、玫瑰与轻托颈。
action_presets.direction_en: Sit on one stool with roses held low and one hand near the neck, preserving shadow direction and anatomy.

action_presets.summary: 手掌靠近眼部，投影与窗光方向一致。
action_presets.direction_en: Raise one hand near the eye line as a natural sun-shield. Keep fingers separated and cast shadow connected to the hand.

action_presets.summary: 托腮或侧脸直视，保留眼部可读性。
action_presets.direction_en: Rest one cheek lightly on a hand while facing the camera or window. Keep elbow support plausible.

action_presets.summary: 宽袖靠近嘴部但不遮挡关键五官。
action_presets.direction_en: Bring one knit sleeve near the lower face while keeping eyes, nose bridge, and most of the mouth readable.

action_presets.summary: 人物握相机，向高机位镜头自然回看。
action_presets.direction_en: Sit at a restaurant table holding one compact camera and turn naturally toward a slightly elevated camera.

action_presets.summary: 两只手分别持简单食物道具，动作清晰。
action_presets.direction_en: Hold two simple food items or chopsticks with clear separated hands. Keep the gesture playful but anatomically explainable.

action_presets.summary: 双手轻触耳机，表情轻松。
action_presets.direction_en: Gently hold both headphone earcups or rest them around the neck. Use a relaxed candid smile.

action_presets.summary: 手持展开书册，身体松弛。
action_presets.direction_en: Stand near shelves holding one open book with relaxed shoulders.

action_presets.summary: 耳机和背包构成轻松户外蹲姿。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a low casual crouch with one elbow near knee, backpack visible, and headphones around the neck.

action_presets.summary: 手持白色咖啡杯，允许细碎窗影。
action_presets.direction_en: Hold one white coffee mug naturally while seated near the window. Keep fingers wrapped around the handle without fusion.

action_presets.summary: 手臂倚靠床沿或枕头，晨光照亮部分脸部。
action_presets.direction_en: Rest one arm on bedding or a chair edge and lean the head slightly toward the arm.

action_presets.summary: 小相机靠近一只眼睛，另一只眼自然眨眼或微眯。
action_presets.direction_en: Lift one compact camera toward one eye. Allow a natural wink or squint while preserving the rest of the face.

action_presets.summary: 门洞倚靠，棒棒糖只作小型点缀。
action_presets.direction_en: Lean one forearm against a doorway and hold or lightly place one small lollipop near the lips without fusion.

action_presets.summary: 低太阳勾勒发丝，侧脸向下或看向画外。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a close side profile or three-quarter profile with a restrained downward or off-frame gaze.

action_presets.summary: 下巴轻抬，让暖光跨过嘴唇与颈部。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a close chin-lift pose through a soft foreground veil. Keep lips, nose bridge, and one eye readable inside or near the beam.

action_presets.summary: 闭眼进入条带光斑，保留嘴唇和鼻梁层次。
action_presets.direction_en: Close the eyes naturally while one narrow warm band crosses eyelids, cheeks, or lips. Keep facial structure readable.

action_presets.name_zh: 床边暖光斑手部靠近下巴
action_presets.summary: 黑色高领坐姿中，手部轻靠下巴但不遮挡识别区。
action_presets.direction_en: Sit or kneel on white drape with one relaxed hand near the chin. Keep fingers separated and the warm face pool bounded.

action_presets.summary: 低头或侧坐，暖光池仅照亮部分脸部。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a quiet seated or kneeling pose with downcast gaze and one small warm patch across the face.

action_presets.summary: 报纸位于眼睛下方，视线从上沿自然露出。
action_presets.direction_en: Hold one generic newspaper below eye level with both hands. Let the eyes peek over the top edge without hiding eyebrows or fusing fingers.

action_presets.summary: 双手捧杯靠近嘴部，窗光落在手部和外套上。
action_presets.direction_en: Hold one ceramic cup with both hands near the mouth while seated in a warm window pool. Keep fingers, cup rim, and sleeve shadows clear.

action_presets.summary: 肩部轻转回看，头发随海风跨过脸部但不遮死双眼。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a close over-shoulder turnback in wind. Allow a few hair strands across the face while keeping both eyes and mouth readable.

action_presets.summary: 俯卧或倚靠沙地，双手轻持海螺。
action_presets.direction_en: Rest on forearms in nearby sand and hold one shell gently near the cheek. Keep elbows, wrists, and shell ridges physically clear.

action_presets.summary: 正面站立，长发受风，直闪与晚霞形成清晰层次。
action_presets.direction_en: Stand frontally with a natural small smile and windblown hair. Keep the sunset horizon dark enough to remain atmospheric.

action_presets.name_zh: 屋顶蓝调侧脸看向远处
action_presets.summary: 侧脸朝向远处，让暖色发丝边缘光落在源侧。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a calm profile or three-quarter rooftop pose with off-frame horizon gaze. Keep warm rim confined to source-facing hair edges.

action_presets.summary: 浅色风衣双手入袋，保持安静站姿。
action_presets.direction_en: Stand with both hands naturally inside coat pockets, shoulders relaxed, and face slightly turned toward restrained fill.

action_presets.summary: 木椅坐姿、低头视线和长阴影形成克制叙事。
action_presets.direction_en: Sit quietly on one field chair with a downward gaze and hands resting separately on lap or chair edge.

action_presets.summary: 发丝跨过脸部但保留至少一只眼和嘴唇轮廓。
action_presets.direction_en: Use an extreme close-up with several wind-led strands crossing the face. Keep one eye, the nose bridge, and mouth contour readable.

action_presets.summary: 手掌或手指进入光池，与脸部光斑构成连续遮挡关系。
action_presets.direction_en: Raise one relaxed hand into the warm patch. Keep finger separation, hand shadow, and face-patch geometry coherent.

action_presets.summary: 指尖轻靠下巴附近，局部暖光落在嘴唇与下颌。
action_presets.direction_en: Place one index finger near the chin or lip line without covering the mouth. Keep the warm spot bounded.

action_presets.summary: 侧脸面向远处，发丝与肩部进入低太阳轮廓光。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a calm side profile with a slight chin lift toward ambient sky fill. Keep flare low-opacity and axis-aligned.

action_presets.summary: 闭眼轻抬下巴，保持颈部线条与发丝高光。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a quiet eyes-closed profile pause under low sun. Preserve neck anatomy and hair highlight roll-off.

action_presets.summary: 侧向经过镜头，手臂、裙摆和背景灯轨沿同一矢量拉伸。
action_presets.direction_en: Move laterally through frame during a controlled pan. Keep one continuous silhouette and no duplicated limbs.

action_presets.summary: 肩部回转并靠近镜头，保留一个清晰身份锚点。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a near-camera shoulder turn with controlled blur. Retain one readable eye or lip contour.

action_presets.summary: 坐在照片墙旁，双手轻抱小熊，眼神自然偏离镜头。
action_presets.direction_en: Sit near a photo wall and hold one teddy bear with separated hands. Keep facial space uncluttered.

action_presets.summary: 双拳放在下巴下方，身体靠窗向外看。
action_presets.direction_en: Lean into the window opening with both fists lightly under the chin, gaze off-frame, elbows naturally supported.

action_presets.summary: 一手调整耳罩或头梁，另一手自然放低。
action_presets.direction_en: Touch one ear cup or the headband while seated. Keep headphones attached to head geometry.

action_presets.summary: 伏桌伸手，手指与鼻梁进入暖窗光。
action_presets.direction_en: Rest near a desk edge and extend one hand forward. Keep fingertip depth and warm patch continuity.

action_presets.summary: 侧脸与毛领在蓝天前形成干净剪影。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a clean side profile with fur collar, breeze-led hair, and ample sky negative space.

action_presets.summary: 佩戴透明眼镜，略微仰头看向天空。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a three-quarter upward gaze with thin clear glasses and a hoodie against pastel sky.

action_presets.summary: 脸部轻靠围巾，眼神离开镜头。
action_presets.direction_en: Nest the lower face into thick scarf folds and use a calm side gaze. Preserve jaw separation and eye clarity.

action_presets.summary: 近距离直视镜头，围巾仅框住下半脸。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a tight soft direct gaze framed by scarf volume without covering identity landmarks.

action_presets.summary: 身体背向镜头，侧脸和长丝带进入透光。
action_presets.direction_en: Turn the body away and reveal a calm side profile; keep one ribbon tied and trailing naturally.

action_presets.summary: 手持单片秋叶，轻微抬头看向飘落叶片。
action_presets.direction_en: Hold one leaf near the face with separated fingers and lift the chin toward falling leaves.

action_presets.summary: 风动发丝横穿脸部，保留一只清晰眼睛和嘴唇轮廓。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a close direct gaze through breeze-led hair inside a dark vehicle or window-side interior. Preserve one eye and lip contour.

action_presets.summary: 双手在下巴或肩线附近轻合，发丝进入侧光。
action_presets.direction_en: Keep hands gently clasped near the lower face while side-window light catches hair strands. Maintain finger separation.

action_presets.summary: 花冠围绕头部，正面直视镜头。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a centered frontal portrait with a physically supported floral halo and calm direct gaze.

action_presets.summary: 用单枝花遮挡一只眼睛，另一只眼保持可读。
action_presets.direction_en: Hold one flower stem in front of one eye. Keep the other eye readable and stem origin visible.

action_presets.summary: 横向躺卧或旋转构图，花冠结构仍保持完整。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a reclined close portrait with intact halo attachment and stable facial orientation.

action_presets.summary: 在走廊中段回身，围巾和大衣顺应身体转动。
action_presets.direction_en: Stand inside a transit corridor and turn back toward camera. Keep scarf folds, coat shoulders, and corridor lines coherent.

action_presets.summary: 在车厢门框中交臂站立，姿态克制。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a full-body arms-cross stance inside the corridor. Preserve door geometry, scarf volume, and hand anatomy.

action_presets.summary: 以半身近景在走廊中柔和直视镜头。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a half-body commute portrait with soft direct gaze and clean corridor depth.

action_presets.name_zh: 卧室窗面反射柔和凝视
action_presets.summary: 隔着玻璃或窗面看向镜头，反射幽影轻微偏移。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a close gaze through one glass plane. Keep reflection softer and offset from the physical face.

action_presets.summary: 坐在窗边轻抿咖啡，杯口和手指清晰。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a seated side profile sip with clear cup rim, finger contact, and window-side posture.

action_presets.summary: 坐姿看向镜头，一只手靠近发丝。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a seated window portrait with one hand near the hairline and restrained reflection layers.

action_presets.summary: 交腿阅读，书本位于腿部平面。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a cross-leg reading pose with book contact, chair support, and cafe depth.

action_presets.name_zh: 城市栏杆针织倚靠直视
action_presets.summary: 双臂自然搭在栏杆上，柔和看镜头。
action_presets.direction_en: Lean both forearms naturally on one railing plane while preserving knit volume and camera lock.

action_presets.summary: 人物站在车辆前一步，身体自然直立。
action_presets.direction_en: Stand one step in front of the yellow vehicle plane with relaxed shoulders and readable accessories.

action_presets.summary: 在海岸植被前回身看向镜头。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a restrained coastal back-turn with level horizon and wind-led hair.

action_presets.summary: 植物阴影穿过脸部但保留眼部识别锚点。
action_presets.direction_en: Use direct close-up with one traceable branch shadow and one readable eye anchor.

action_presets.summary: 侧面轮廓与墙面三角光斑保持同一方向。
action_presets.direction_en: Use profile stance against one triangular wall beam with coherent aperture direction.

action_presets.summary: 通过近景花瓶和枝叶框住面部。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a vase or branch foreground to frame the face while preserving one eye, nose contour, and mouth relation.

action_presets.summary: 坐在石阶或岩石上举起红灯笼。
action_presets.direction_en: Sit on a rock or step and lift one red lantern within reachable arm distance; preserve handle and gravity.

action_presets.summary: 站立时花枝从口袋或手部自然延伸。
action_presets.direction_en: Use an offset standing lookbook pose with grounded feet and carnations attached to pockets or hands.

action_presets.summary: 落座地面，花枝沿地面散开。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a seated floor pose with clear hip-leg contact and gravity-led carnation scatter.

action_presets.summary: 单手从头顶上方垂下一枝花。
action_presets.direction_en: Hold one carnation stem above the head with readable wrist, stem continuity, and clean face framing.

action_presets.name_zh: 猩红海报夸张缩短斜躺
action_presets.summary: 斜躺或踢腿姿态，近景鞋履放大但肢体连续。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a controlled low-angle recline or kicked-leg pose with readable limb continuity and grounded near footwear.

action_presets.name_zh: 林下近景抬头与标题留白
action_presets.summary: 林下近景轻抬头，前景枝叶保持真实景深。
action_presets.direction_en: Use a close forest-understory portrait with near foliage blur, readable eyes and mouth, and a center-bottom caption-safe zone.
